### Description of the pricing of domestic and international / Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan SMS packages of Alibaba Cloud

* * *

** The following is the official introduction to SMS charging!

To learn more about the unit price of a specific country/region or the specifications of the packages, please register an account and log in to the latest pricing page of the Alibaba Cloud console.
https://www.aliyun.com/

#### I. Charging method of the domestic SMS service

**1. Payment modes**

Alibaba Cloud domestic SMS supports two payment modes: **package** and **pay-as-you-go**; users can choose the optimal solution according to the sending volume and SMS type.

**2. Package mode**

* **Applicable scope**: only domestic text SMS (sent from a China mainland IP), supporting three types: verification code, notification SMS and marketing SMS.
* **Price and specifications**:

| SMS type | Number of messages | Total package price (CNY) | Unit price (CNY/message) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| General | 1000 | 50 | 0.05 |
| | 2000 | 100 | 0.05 |
| | 5000 | 250 | 0.05 |
| | 15,000 | 705 | 0.047 |
| | 50,000 | 2150 | 0.043 |
| | 200,000 | 8400 | 0.042 |
| | 500,000 | 20500 | 0.041 |
| | 1,000,000 | 40000 | 0.04 |
| | 3,000,000 | 117000 | 0.039 |

* **Validity period**: the validity period of a regular package is **2 years**. The unused part after expiration cannot be refunded or extended.
* **Deduction rules**: **the package that expires earliest is consumed first**; the excess part is charged on a pay-as-you-go basis.
* **Automatic renewal**: the automatic renewal function can be enabled, which automatically deducts the fee and purchases a new package when the balance is insufficient or before expiration.

**3. Pay-as-you-go mode**

* **Tiered charging**: the unit price is dynamically adjusted according to the monthly sending volume, and charging is performed across tiers in real time.
* **Price example (system SMS / verification code / notification SMS)**:

| Sending volume range (messages/month) | Unit price (CNY/message) |
| --- | --- |
| ≤100,000 | 0.045 |
| 100,000~300,000 | 0.040 |
| 300,000~500,000 | 0.039 |
| 500,000~1,000,000 | 0.038 |
| 1,000,000~3,000,000 | 0.037 |
| >3,000,000 | 0.036 |

* **Marketing SMS costs more**: in pay-as-you-go mode, the unit price of marketing SMS is about 0.01 CNY/message higher than that of system SMS (for example, the unit price of marketing SMS for more than 3 million messages is 0.046 CNY).

**4. Important restrictions and notes**

* **Certification requirements**: individual users can only apply for verification code and notification SMS templates; enterprise users can use all types.
* **Impact of arrears**: when the account is in arrears, **packages cannot be used**, and new packages cannot be purchased.
* **IP restriction**: domestic SMS must be sent from a **China mainland IP**.
* **Long SMS charging**: SMS longer than 70 characters is split and charged at **67 characters/message** (for example, 160 characters is counted as 3 messages).

* * *

#### II. Charging method of the international / Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan SMS service

**1. Payment modes**

Both **packages** and **pay-as-you-go** are supported, but the charging rules are different:

* **Package**: after purchase, it is deducted first, and the remaining part is charged on a pay-as-you-go basis, but **refunds and extensions are not supported**.
* **Pay-as-you-go**: charged upon sending (regardless of whether the carrier receives it successfully), according to the unit price of the destination country/region.

**2. Package mode**

* **Price example (taking the "Global Package" as an example)**:

| Package specification (messages) | Global Plus package price (CNY) | Global package price (CNY) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1000 | 1500 | 750 |
| 5000 | 7500 | 3750 |
| 10000 | 15000 | 7500 |

* **Packages for special countries/regions**: countries such as South Africa and Ireland have separate pricing (see the official document for details).

**3. Pay-as-you-go mode**

* **Unit price differences**: the unit price varies significantly between countries/regions (for example, Hong Kong, China 0.42 CNY/message, Thailand 0.0435 CNY/message).
* **QPS limits**:
  * Package mode: **30 times/second** per account.
  * Pay-as-you-go mode: **2000 times/second** per account.

**4. Important restrictions and notes**

* **Charging rule**: international SMS is **charged upon submission**, regardless of whether the carrier receives it successfully.
* **Unsupported case**: sending SMS from an overseas IP is not supported.
* **Automatic renewal**: international SMS packages **do not support** the automatic renewal function.

* * *

#### III. Expense statistics and bill query

* **Domestic SMS bill**: settled at the end of the month; the expense details can be viewed by month and product type. Path: SMS console → Business Statistics → Expense Statistics.
* **International / Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan SMS bill**: the same path as domestic SMS, but the SMS type and the destination country/region need to be distinguished.

* * *

#### IV. Description of other expenses

1. **Log service fee**:
   * The SMS service provides a free log storage quota of **5 million SMS** by default; the excess part is charged according to the charging rules of the log service.
2. **Server deployment requirements**:
   * Domestic SMS needs to be sent from a **China mainland IP**, and international SMS needs to be sent through the Alibaba Cloud China site service.
